coverage_gaps.reason: Every source job/matrix is accounted in workflow_jobs, but unmapped validation, build, command, publisher and orchestration jobs remain explicit profile-contract gaps; a matrix snapshot is not expanded variant coverage or successful execution. Existing generic profiles are diagnostic, not proof of workflow parity.

Two nostrc-ci matrix profiles retain exact configure/command/environment defaults and configured registration memberships. The three existing -E exclusions remain unexecuted gaps, not expected passes. Generic root exclusion admission, named audit/fuzz phases, ambient setup suffixes and dependency-worker routing are not implemented by metadata. Linux registration evidence is arm64 only, not hosted x86_64. No latency-test exclusion is added. Runtime/header/input union and independent macOS failure remain open.

Shared GH_SAN_* configuration and all 62 exact selected registrations match the workflow and an actual Linux/arm64 configure. The other configured registrations are not sanitizer members. Hosted x86_64, sanitizer execution/skip enforcement, post-build headers, runtime/semantic closure and worker routing remain unproven. {source_root} environment expansion must be execution-owner validated before running this profile; no local/runtime safety or skip policy is relaxed. Exact phase_environments are metadata only: shared environment is empty; configure/build environments differ from test. Core plus adapter phase application, expansion and fingerprint admission are pending; this profile is not execution-eligible.

Existing libgo-ci.yml build-and-test macOS ASan/UBSan variant excludes GoChannelStressTest for intermittent timeout. The other 32 registrations are exact check members. This is an explicit coverage gap, not an expected skip, advisory pass or completed check; the realization audit must continue reporting the unclaimed registration until exclusion schema/policy is coordinated. Effective Test-step ASAN_OPTIONS is detect_leaks=0 (overrides the earlier strict_string_checks setting).

Initial logical inventory is non-enforcing: complete native/toolchain/sanitizer/optional profile union and exact registration membership require realization plus workflow migration. Existing legacy gates remain authoritative.
W11 measured baselines, 20 PRs, two broad runs and actual protection cutover NOT RUN; no selective production acceptance.

.github/workflows/groundhog-release.yml:.matrix_source:
matrix:
        include:
          - { arch: x86_64, runner: ubuntu-24.04, image: 'archlinux:latest' }
          # The official archlinux image is x86_64 only. Arch Linux ARM is
          # what Linux-on-Android setups run (Termux proot-distro archlinux,
          # chroots), so the aarch64 package is built on an Arch Linux ARM
          # root: menci/archlinuxarm is rebuilt daily from the official
          # ArchLinuxARM-aarch64 rootfs with the archlinuxarm keyring
          # initialised. Pinned by digest; bump it deliberately.
          - arch: aarch64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            image: 'menci/archlinuxarm@sha256:57ed42430d3d3f22beb2983de1aa23396b27fcf33ebf5dd781947cdc1038a640'

.github/workflows/libgo-ci.yml:build-and.matrix_source:
matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        # tsan keeps the default TSAN configuration (single-lock ring);
        # tsan_mpmc keeps the MPMC slot protocol every other build ships, so
        # the lock-free channel paths get ThreadSanitizer coverage too
        # (nostrc-75rv review F8).
        sanitizer: [asan_ubsan, tsan, tsan_mpmc]

.github/workflows/nostr-homed-ci.yml:bui.matrix_source:
matrix:
        include:
          - distro: ubuntu-24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
            update: apt-get update
            install: >-
              apt-get install -y build-essential cmake pkg-config ninja-build
              libjansson-dev libglib2.0-dev libgirepository1.0-dev
              libsqlite3-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev
              libfuse3-dev fuse3
              libssl-dev libsecp256k1-dev
              libwebsockets-dev libnsync-dev libsodium-dev libsoup-3.0-dev
          - distro: debian-bookworm
            image: debian:bookworm
            update: apt-get update
            install: >-
              apt-get install -y build-essential cmake pkg-config ninja-build
              libjansson-dev libglib2.0-dev gir1.2-glib-2.0
              libsqlite3-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev
              libfuse3-dev fuse3
              libssl-dev libsecp256k1-dev
              libwebsockets-dev libnsync-dev libsodium-dev libsoup-3.0-dev
          - distro: fedora-40
            image: fedora:40
            update: dnf -y update
            install: >-
              dnf -y install @development-tools cmake ninja-build pkgconf-pkg-config gcc-c++
              jansson-devel glib2-devel gobject-introspection-devel
              sqlite-devel libcurl-devel
              fuse3-devel
              openssl-devel libsecp256k1-devel
              libwebsockets-devel libsodium-devel libsoup3-devel
          - distro: archlinux
            image: archlinux:latest
            update: pacman -Syu --noconfirm
            install: >-
              pacman -S --noconfirm base-devel cmake ninja pkgconf
              jansson glib2 gobject-introspection sqlite curl
              fuse3
              openssl libsecp256k1 libwebsockets libsodium libsoup3

.github/workflows/signet-ci.yml:build-an.matrix_source:
matrix:
        passkeys: [ 'OFF', 'ON' ]
        sqlcipher: [ 'OFF', 'ON' ]
        build_type: [ 'Debug' ]
        include:
          # Exercise binding-race and forced-secret regressions in one test
          # build; the Release configuration below keeps hooks disabled.
          - passkeys: 'ON'
            sqlcipher: 'OFF'
            build_type: 'Debug'
            test_hooks: 'ON'
          # fp-52iq: assurance comes from running tests the way the project is
          # shipped. Release optimizes signet_core and defines NDEBUG, so cover
          # the shipped configuration too instead of testing Debug only.
          - passkeys: 'ON'
            sqlcipher: 'ON'
            build_type: 'Release'
